44127023.article_content:
Chinese paraglider claims to survive accidental 8,000m-high flight
1 day ago
Share
Save
Joel Guinto
BBC News
Share
Save
Douyin/CCTV
A still from the viral video which purported to show a paraglider flying at 8,000m
A Chinese paraglider has claimed to have survived being accidentally propelled 8,500m (27,800ft) into the sky above north-west China, state media report.
Peng Yujiang, 55, says he was testing new equipment at 3,000m above sea level, over the Qilian mountains, when a rare updraft or air current known as a "cloud suck" pulled him about 5,000m higher into a cloud formation.
Saturday's events were filmed on a camera mounted on Mr Peng's glider and has gone viral after being posted on Douyin, China's version of TikTok.
The footage, which showed Mr Peng holding onto the glider's controls with his face and much of his body covered in ice crystals, has since been questioned by US broadcaster NBC.
NBC said the logo of an artificial intelligence company had been cropped out of the footage.
The BBC has been unable to independently verify the video, but the incident was widely reported in China, with Mr Peng giving an interview to journalists.
"It was terrifying... Everything was white. I couldn't see any direction. Without the compass, I wouldn't have known which way I was going. I thought I was flying straight, but in reality, I was spinning," he told China Media Group.
Mr Peng said he narrowly survived death as oxygen is thin at that altitude - slightly lower than the 8,849m peak of Mount Everest. Temperatures can also fall to -40C.
"I wanted to come down quickly, but I just couldn't. I was lifted higher and higher until I was inside the cloud," he said.
Mr Peng, who has been paragliding for four and a half years, said he might have lost consciousness during his descent.
As a result of the footage, Mr Peng has been suspended for six months because the flight was unauthorised, state-run Global Times reported. Officials are also investigating the incident.
Update 30 May 2025: An earlier version of this article included a video of footage shared on Chinese social media and broadcast on state television purporting to show the paraglider's flight. This has been removed while we investigate further after questions were raised about its authenticity.

data.title: Build API integrations with SQL and YAML – no SaaS lock-in, no drag-and-drop UIs
data.author: maxgrinev
data.article_summary:
Sequor是一个以SQL为中心的平台，用于构建无锁定和黑盒的API集成。它通过将API执行与SQL逻辑结合，提供一个开放、灵活的平台，支持双向数据流，允许在API和数据库表之间传输数据。Sequor利用数据库存储中间数据，充分发挥SQL在数据转换、分析和业务逻辑中的作用，消除了传统iPaaS应用集成和ETL数据管道之间的界限。

Sequor采用代码优先的方法（YAML定义流程，Jinja或Python用于动态参数，SQL用于逻辑），支持版本控制、协作、CI/CD和本地开发。其主要功能包括执行API请求、数据转换和控制语句等操作，通过具体示例展示了从数据获取到复杂数据处理的能力。Sequor提供透明配置和开放技术，避免SaaS锁定，让数据团队完全控制其集成管道。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于融合多种技术（YAML、SQL、Python等）的平台的评价与争议

不同观点：
• **sscarduzio**：认为该平台通过将API执行与SQL逻辑结合，提供了一个开放且灵活的平台，但注意到YAML文件中存在大量Python代码，可能影响可读性。

• **tnolet**：认为这种方法是“泄漏的抽象”，即将Python代码替换为YAML层，但仍需要编写Python代码，可能导致IDE解析困难，增加复杂性。

Sequor
Sequor is a SQL-centric workflow platform for building reliable API integrations in modern data stacks. It's the open alternative to black-box SaaS connectors, giving data teams complete control over their integration pipelines.
Sequor fuses API execution with your database, enabling bidirectional data flow between APIs and database tables. By storing intermediate data in your database, you can leverage the full power of SQL for transformations, analytics, and business logic. This unified execution model eliminates the traditional boundary between iPaaS-style app integration and ETL-style data pipelines.
With Sequor's code-first approach (YAML for flows, Jinja or Python for dynamic parameters, and SQL for logic), you can apply software engineering best practices to integrations: version control, collaboration, CI/CD, and local development.
Own
,
control
, and
scale
your integrations with transparent configuration, familiar open technologies, and without SaaS lock-in.
How Sequor works
Sequor is designed around an intuitive YAML-based workflow definition. Every integration  flow is built from these powerful operations:
http_request
- Execute API calls with database integration that iterates over input records, performs dynamic HTTP requests, and maps responses back to database tables. Use Jinja templates or Python snippets for dynamic parameterization.
transform
- Apply SQL queries to prepare data for API calls or process API results, leveraging the full power of your database for data manipulation.
control statements
- Build robust workflows with if-then-else conditionals, while loops, try-catch error handling, and more. These high-level orchestration capabilities ensure your integrations handle edge cases gracefully without custom code.

data.title: Fractran Interpreter
data.author: ColinWright
data.article_summary: Fractran是一种由数学家约翰·康威发明的图灵完备的深奥编程语言。一个Fractran程序由一组正分数和一个初始正整数输入n组成。程序运行规则如下：寻找列表中第一个使n乘以该分数结果为整数的 fraction f，然后用nf替换n，重复此过程，直到没有任何分数能使n乘积为整数时，程序停止。该文章提供了一个Fractran解释器的示例和源代码链接，用于演示如何运行Fractran程序并输出结果，例如生成素数序列。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Fractran编程语言的实现与应用

不同观点：
• siraben认为Fractran看起来最初不可能编写任何程序，但通过系统性地跟踪例子可以学会。他提到自己用Haskell编写了一个带优化器的汇编器，使得可以用类似汇编的风格编写程序。他提供了具体的代码示例，展示了如何定义和运行一个计算总和的程序，并给出了运行汇编器后的输出结果，包括程序长度和具体的分数序列。

• shawn_w则表示自己用Racket实现了一个解释器，用于解释Fractran程序，并且可以以懒惰求值的方式返回结果。他指出，理解如何从"primegame"程序中获取实际的质数是难点所在，但没有提供具体的代码示例。

补充讨论：
• siraben的评论中详细描述了如何用Haskell实现Fractran汇编器，并展示了具体程序的运行结果，包括分数序列和优化后的输出，这表明他对Fractran的深入理解和实践经验。

• shawn_w的评论则侧重于使用Racket实现解释器，强调了懒惰求值的返回方式，并指出理解程序逻辑中的质数生成是关键挑战，但没有深入展开具体实现细节。

争议焦点：
• 没有明显的争议，但两者在实现方式上有所不同：siraben使用Haskell并侧重于汇编器和优化器，而shawn_w使用Racket并强调懒惰求值的解释器。这反映了不同编程语言和实现策略在处理同一问题上的多样性。

What is Fractran?
From wikipedia
Fractran
:
FRACTRAN is a Turing-complete esoteric programming language invented by the mathematician John Conway. A FRACTRAN program is an ordered list of positive fractions together with an initial positive integer input n. The program is run by updating the integer n as follows:
for the first fraction f in the list for which nf is an integer, replace n by nf
repeat this rule until no fraction in the list produces an integer when multiplied by n, then halt.

data.title: OpenBao Namespaces
data.author: gslin
data.article_summary:
OpenBao Secret Manager推出了**Namespaces**功能，旨在为机密信息管理提供强大的多租户支持和细粒度的隔离。Namespaces是OpenBao实例中的逻辑分区，作为团队、组织或应用独立操作的隔离环境。每个Namespace拥有自己的策略、认证方法、机密引擎、令牌和身份组，支持安全的多租户模式，并允许内部用户自助管理环境。

### 主要特点：
1. **强隔离性**：不同租户（如团队、组织或应用）在各自Namespace中操作，互不干扰。
2. **权限严格**：用户权限限制在其Namespace内，无法访问或修改其他资源。
3. **自助管理**：Namespace管理员可自行管理策略、引擎和配额，减轻集群管理员负担。
4. **水平扩展**：支持大规模部署，保持简单集群拓扑。

### 使用方法：
- 使用`bao namespace`子命令创建和管理Namespaces。
- 示例：创建租户及其子Namespace，并在其中启用KV机密引擎。
- 通过`-ns`参数在Namespace中操作资源（如创建、读取机密）。

Namespaces功能支持多租户场景，简化了管理和操作流程。

We are excited to introduce
Namespaces
to the OpenBao Secret Manager – a powerful feature designed to bring robust multi-tenancy and fine-grained isolation to your secrets management workflows.
What Are Namespaces?
​
Namespaces in OpenBao are logical partitions within a single OpenBao instance, functioning as isolated environments where teams, organizations, or applications can operate independently.
Each namespace acts like a mini-OpenBao, with its own policies, authentication methods, secret engines, tokens, and identity groups. This architecture enables organizations to implement a true
OpenBao-as-a-Service
model, empowering internal customers to self-manage their environments securely and efficiently.
Why Namespaces?
​
Strong isolation between teams, business units, or tenants becomes critical as organizations scale, especially when handling sensitive data.
Namespaces enable secure multi-tenancy. Each tenant (e.g., team, organisation, or application) operates within its namespace, isolated from others. Permissions are strictly scoped, preventing users from accessing or interfering with resources outside their assigned namespace.
Furthermore, namespaces enable the delegation of administration and promote self-service. Namespace admins can manage their own policies, secret engines, auth modes, or even quotas, without impacting other tenants, reducing the burden on cluster-level operators.
Finally, namespaces are one of a few planned stepping stones towards OpenBao's
horizontal scalability
journey. OpenBao aims to allow support for large deployments with many infrequently accessed mounts, without overloading cluster nodes, while keeping a simpler cluster topology.
How to use Namespaces
​
Namespaces will enable plenty of use cases and multi-tenancy scenarios. Let's consider a possible namespace setup for a SaaS Company. The platform team retains a top-level namespace for shared infrastructure. On the other hand, each tenant receives a fully isolated namespace to, e.g., model a staging system.
An example namespace structure to separate tenants and the platform team.
To use this new feature, no extra setup or configuration is required. The OpenBao CLI now features a special
namespace
sub-command, which can be used to administrate Namespaces.
To recreate the structure of the given example, we would do the following workflow:
Create Namespaces:
# creates a namespace "tenant" on root-level
$ bao namespace create tenants
# creates a child-namespace within tenants
$ bao namespace create -ns tenants tenant-c
# creates a child-namespace within tenants/tenants-c
$ bao namespace create -ns tenants/tenant-c prod
Note how we use the
-ns
(short form for
-namespace
) flag to create a child-namepace
tenant-c
within the namespace
tenant
. To view status and metadata, we can utilize the
lookup
command:
$ bao namespace lookup -ns tenants/tenant-c prod
Key                Value
---                -----
custom_metadata    map[]
id                 8QujqL
path               tenants/tenant-c/prod/
tainted            false
uuid               f06d10c7-1300-6c4d-8616-c203b5fdf705
Furthermore, we can easily enumerate our hierarchy of namespaces by using the
scan
subcommand.
$ bao namespace scan
Keys
----
tenants/
tenants/tenant-c/
tenants/tenant-c/prod/
Create Resources within Namespaces
Since the introduction of Namespaces, many OpenBao commands have become namespace-aware. Similar to our example before, we can add
-namespace
or in short
-ns
to the command.
For demonstration purposes, let's create a KV secrets engine and populate it with a secret.
$ bao secrets enable -ns=tenants/tenant-c/prod -description="Production Secrets" kv
Success! Enabled the kv secrets engine at: kv/
Now that we have created a new kv secrets engine, it will be listed among our default engines:
$ bao secrets list -ns tenants/tenant-c/prod
Path          Type            Accessor              Description
----          ----            --------              -----------
cubbyhole/    ns_cubbyhole    cubbyhole_9a4e44d3    per-token private secret storage
identity/     ns_identity     identity_61c42408     identity store
kv/           kv              kv_b993bbec           Production Secrets
sys/          ns_system       system_ba514ba2       system endpoints used for control, policy and debugging
Let's read and write a secret...
# Create the secret within namespace
$ bao kv put -namespace=tenants/tenant-c/prod -mount=kv auth-token foo=bar
Success! Data written to: kv/auth-token
# Read it
$ bao kv get -namespace=tenants/tenant-c/prod -mount=kv auth-token
=== Data ===
Key    Value
---    -----
foo    bar
Lifecycle Operations
Over time, tenants will inevitably require various changes and customizations to their namespaces. Moving the administration away from the OpenBao operators means that the tenant operator can perform those changes on demand and individually. Consequently, we implemented the associated (and probably expected) lifecycle features such as:
Namespace-awa

- 使用`bao namespace`子命令创建和管理Namespaces。
- 示例：创建租户及其子Namespace，并在其中启用KV机密引擎。
- 通过`-ns`参数在Namespace中操作资源（如创建、读取机密）。

Namespaces功能支持多租户场景，简化了管理和操作流程。

data.title: Human coders are still better than LLMs
data.author: longwave
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（大型语言模型）在软件工程和编码中的应用及其未来影响

不同观点：
• mattnewton：认为LLM目前作为一个智能的橡皮鸭（rubber duck）调试工具很有价值，但不确定其未来两年是否仍会如此。
• UncleOxidant：认为尽管LLM目前在生成代码方面有很大进步，但仍存在一些问题如误导用户，未来改进幅度可能会减小，但仍会有所提升。
• ChrisMarshallNY：强调优秀程序员的表现优于LLM， mediocre的程序员可能受益更多，并通过个人经历说明人类工程师的不可替代性。
• yua_mikami：指出软件工程不仅仅是写代码，还包括需求分析和社会因素，LLM在这些方面难以替代人类。
• wanderingstan：认为LLM在某些重复性任务上表现优于大多数开发者，但对复杂任务仍需人类介入。
• loudmax：公司若利用LLM提升员工生产力将繁荣，但若试图完全取代员工则会失败。
• acquisitionsilk：担忧商业世界对“好代码”的忽视，认为股东和管理层只关注利润，而不在乎代码质量。
• am17an：认为程序员应关注LLM的发展趋势，未来AGI（通用人工智能）可能使多数白领工作不再安全。
• bouncycastle：通过个人经历说明LLM在处理复杂任务时可能产生错误，仍需人类把关。
• frogperson：认为LLM难以处理需要大量上下文和跨部门规则的软件项目，当前能力有限。
• smilbandit：认为LLM有帮助但有时过于侵入，仍需人工审查代码。
• solatic：强调人类编码是政治决策过程，LLM无法自行理解项目的优先级和取舍。
• austin-cheney：认为多数开发者因自身原因可能被AI取代，开发者将自己 commoditize（商品化）导致了这种局面。
• some-guy：认为LLM在引导和基础任务上提供了时间节省，但在处理复杂遗留代码时仍不足。
• pupppet：质疑LLM仅通过模式识别能否真正擅长某项任务，认为其表现最多只能达到平均水平。

补充讨论：
• LLM在编码中的角色和价值：从橡皮鸭调试工具到代码生成工具，讨论了LLM在不同场景中的实际应用和局限性。
• 人类程序员的不可替代性：通过具体案例和经验，强调人类在复杂决策、需求分析和社会互动中的独特作用。
• LLM的未来发展：对LLM未来改进的预期及其在软件工程中可能产生的影响，包括对就业市场和代码质量的潜在影响。
• 商业和经济因素：讨论了商业环境对代码质量和开发者角色的影响，以及管理层在采用LLM方面的可能误区。

争议焦点：
• LLM能否在未来替代人类程序员：一些人认为LLM有潜力，但目前仍需人类把关和介入；另一些人则认为LLM的进步可能导致部分开发者被取代。
• LLM在复杂软件项目中的能力和局限性：讨论了LLM在处理需要大量上下文和跨部门规则的项目时的表现和局限。

data.title: WeatherStar 4000+: Weather Channel Simulator
data.author: adam_gyroscope
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了WeatherStar 4000+系统（版本5.21.10）的天气预报界面。用户可以输入位置查看当前天气情况和每小时预报，包括温度、风速、云量和降水概率。此外，还提供旅行预报、区域观测、日出日落时间、风暴预测等信息。用户可以访问详细预报、雷达图和设置选项，并分享或复制预报链接。文章还列出了与地点、雷达和系统版本相关的技术信息。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：复刻90年代Weather Channel天气预报的技术与怀旧情感

不同观点：
• [技术复刻与怀旧] **ndiddy** 提到有人复刻了WeatherStar 4000的硬件并编写了新固件，以重现90年代的天气预报图形，因为原始固件已经丢失。该项目通过真实硬件运行，除了没有Weather Channel的标志以避免商标问题。
• [个人项目展示] **post_break** 分享了自己使用树莓派和3D打印显示器模拟CRT屏幕，24/7运行WeatherStar的项目，并提供了相关链接和代码。他最初尝试使用真正的CRT电视，但因频率问题感到不适。
• [音乐关联] **gasgiant** 提到Pat Metheny Group的音乐被称为“Weather Channel Music”，并通过一个有趣的故事说明某些音乐与Weather Channel的关联。
• [音乐细节] **jader201** 认为只有播放The Rippingtons的音乐才能真正重现90年代Weather Channel的感觉，并提供了一个YouTube链接。

补充讨论：
• [历史保存与技术细节] **doawoo** 提到自己拥有SGI O2上的WeatherStar版本，包括环境脚本和HTML手册，并计划上传到一个存档位置。
• [怀旧情感] **bdbenton5255** 表达了对旧技术的怀旧之情，认为这些细节曾塑造了生活的温暖，带有一种苦乐参半的感觉。
• [原始版本] **ZYbCRq22HbJ2y7** 提供了项目的原始版本链接。
• [期望与现实] **socalgal2** 原本期望一个AI生成的天气主播描述天气，而不是当前的模拟形式。
• [功能建议] **jasonpeacock** 建议将选项存储在URL中，并提供退出全屏模式的快捷键。
• [高度评价] **gdubs** 对该项目给予高度评价，认为其在移动设备上提供了很好的怀旧体验。
• [真实还原] **burnt-resistor** 认为该项目非常逼真，只需添加糟糕的电梯音乐和偶尔的旁白即可完全还原90年代末/2000年代初的体验。
• [技术回忆] **catgirlinspace** 回忆了Local on the 8s的功能，特别是在DirecTV上的工作方式，并提供了一个YouTube视频链接。
• [批评与怀旧] **theturtle** 批评了Weather Channel的现状，怀念过去的无天气相关节目和未命名冬季风暴的时代。
• [技术求助] **disposition2** 寻求帮助，希望通过VLC流式传输个人天气频道，并分享了自己的尝试和问题。
• [地域限制] **harwoodr** 询问该项目是否仅适用于美国地区。

争议焦点：
• 对Weather Channel现状的不满与怀旧情感之间的对比，特别是对其内容变化和主持人的批评。

data.title: The Art of the Critic
data.author: benbreen
data.article_summary: 本文探讨了亨利·詹姆斯的文学批评艺术及其对当时文学批评状态的看法。詹姆斯对同时代英国小说的批评十分尖锐，认为许多作品缺乏深度，尤其是对查尔斯·狄更斯的批评，他认为狄更斯虽是出色的观察者和幽默家，但缺乏哲学深度，无法增进对人性的理解。文章还提到詹姆斯年轻时的雄心和早期的评论作品，如对《我们共同的朋友》的批评。此外，文章讨论了詹姆斯对法国作家巴尔扎克的长期研究和赞赏，认为巴尔扎克的细节描写虽过于繁杂，但也展现了他独特的叙事风格和艺术追求。詹姆斯强调，优秀的批评需要敏锐的感知力和出色的表达能力，而他在批评实践中展现了这种才华。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：亨利·詹姆斯（Henry James）的文学地位和评论家的角色与价值

不同观点：
• billfruit认为亨利·詹姆斯的作品曾经被视为成年人的阅读乐趣之一，因为他深入分析了复杂世界中人们的行为和选择，这些分析与人们对自己生活的反思相似。不过，billfruit猜测詹姆斯目前不再那么受欢迎。

• ahalbert4引用了弗拉基米尔·纳博科夫（Vladimir Nabokov）对亨利·詹姆斯的评价。纳博科夫表示自己对詹姆斯相当不喜欢，但承认詹姆斯的某些措辞能带来一种“电击般的刺激”，不过他否认詹姆斯是天才。

• hresvelgr认为批评家的角色价值有限，批评应该来自实践的艺术家。他强调个人品味的重要性，并主张人们应该追随自己感兴趣的东西，而不是被批评家的意见左右。他还指出，伟大的艺术作品自然会持久存在。

• nyeah提供了一个替代解释，指出有时候批评家只是不喜欢某些东西，并以亨利·詹姆斯为例，表明批评可能只是个人喜好的反映，而不是客观的评价。

• miiiiiike分享了与职业批评家共事的负面经历，描述了他们如何坚持自己的错误意见，并用复杂的言辞和战术来维护自己的观点，甚至在面对错误时也会攻击他人。miiiiiike认为批评家往往是自私和短视的，并给出了一些与此类人打交道的建议。

补充讨论：

“The floods of tepid soap and water which under the name of novels are being vomited forth in England, seem to me,” Henry James wrote, “to do little honour to our race.” In February 1884, 40-year-old James dismissed contemporary British novels in a letter to American novelist and editor William Dean Howells. James then went on to laud Howells as “the great American naturalist” before tempering his praise: “I don't think you go far enough, and you are haunted with romantic phantoms and a tendency to factitious glosses; but you are in the right path, and I wish you repeated triumphs there.”
James had opinions. He also had the language — and the critical sensibility — with which to effectively, and lyrically, express those opinions. Criticism without flair is dull, and criticism without sensibility is useless. James had plied his critical trade for years; a notable early work was a terrible gift for Charles Dickens a few days before Christmas in 1865. Writing of
Our Mutual Friend
for
The Nation
, James dismissed the novel as “poor with the poverty not of momentary embarrassment, but of permanent exhaustion.”
Bleak House
was “forced,”
Little Dorrit
“labored,” and
Our Mutual Friend
“dug out as with a spade and a pickaxe.” “Seldom,” James affirms, “had we read a book so intensely written, so little seen, known, or felt.”
James’ criticism was especially sharp because he identifies Dickens’ literary failings as inextricable from the novelist’s method and sense.
Our Mutual Friend
was not merely a bad book, a misfire. Dickens was perhaps incapable of better. He seems to only create “figure[s],” and in doing so “added nothing to our understanding of human character.” Dickens was “a great observer and a great humorist,” but those are skills of attention and entertainment. James is clear: Dickens “is nothing of a philosopher.” And that is a grave sin, for “a novelist very soon has need of a little philosophy.”
Dickens was 53: a celebrated, prolific writer. James was 22; he’d left Harvard Law after a year, and had only published a few, forgettable stories. Yet James was ambitious, and he could write well, and — perhaps most importantly — there was a space for critics to practice their craft.
“Most people don’t read criticism, not beyond the length of a review,” Michael Gorra acknowledges in
Portrait of a Novel: Henry James and the Making of an American Masterpiece
. Yet they do “read narrative,” and his 2012 biography of the novelist manages to embed criticism within story. Gorra is the ideal curator of James’ essays; he has a deft sense of the novelist’s life and language, and his curation of
On Writers and Writing: Selected Essays
collects a healthy range of work. Here we see classic James, as in the essential essay “The Art of Fiction,” as well as his reviews of contemporary novels, expansive memorials and valedictions, and examinations of the forms of fiction.
In 1905, James spoke to the Contemporary Club of Philadelphia, a literary and artistic group (Walt Whitman and Woodrow Wilson had been previous guests). His subject was the French writer Honoré de Balzac. James had been writing about Balzac for thirty years. Balzac was James’ lodestar: James had “learned from him more of the lessons of the engaging mystery of fiction than from anyone else.”
James owed much to Balzac, and his debt is revealed through the care of his engagement rather than mere deference. Balzac’s “inordinate passion for detail” is “also his great fault,” yet such saturation is “essentially prescribed by the terms of his plan.” A critic needs to see small and think big, and James was able to perceive Balzac’s narrative method as being “characteristic and constructive.” Although Balzac’s details “multiplied almost to madness,” the style revealed “the measure of his hallucination.” Balzac wished to animate “the palpable, provable world before him,” yet his singular vision meant that he “collected his experience within himself.”

44123474.article_summary: 本文探讨了亨利·詹姆斯的文学批评艺术及其对当时文学批评状态的看法。詹姆斯对同时代英国小说的批评十分尖锐，认为许多作品缺乏深度，尤其是对查尔斯·狄更斯的批评，他认为狄更斯虽是出色的观察者和幽默家，但缺乏哲学深度，无法增进对人性的理解。文章还提到詹姆斯年轻时的雄心和早期的评论作品，如对《我们共同的朋友》的批评。此外，文章讨论了詹姆斯对法国作家巴尔扎克的长期研究和赞赏，认为巴尔扎克的细节描写虽过于繁杂，但也展现了他独特的叙事风格和艺术追求。詹姆斯强调，优秀的批评需要敏锐的感知力和出色的表达能力，而他在批评实践中展现了这种才华。

data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种用于锂离子电池硅负极的筛孔设计，解决了硅电极在充放电过程中因体积膨胀和电化学副反应导致的稳定性和快充性能不足的问题。该设计利用内部纳米孔容纳硅的变形，外部亚纳米孔促进离子快速传输，并通过筛分效应形成富无机物的固体电解质界面，限制硅膨胀，缓解有害晶相的形成。实验结果显示，该设计实现了低膨胀（58%）、高库仑效率（93.6%初始效率，99.9%循环效率）和低容量衰减（每周期0.015%）。实用化软包电池在2安培下经过1700次循环后仍保持80%容量，并具备10分钟快充能力，有效平衡了机械稳定性与电化学性能。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：硅作为锂电池负极材料的优缺点及研究进展

不同观点：
• [支持硅作为负极材料的观点]  
   硅与锂具有很强的结合能力，使其成为高能量密度的负极材料，而且硅材料便宜且资源丰富。研究人员通过将硅电极制成海绵状结构，解决了硅在吸收锂时发生机械膨胀的问题，从而提高了电池寿命。实验电池在1700次充放电循环后仍能保持80%的容量，表现非常出色。

• [对硅负极材料的质疑和担忧]  
   硅在吸收锂的过程中会发生机械膨胀，导致电池寿命缩短，电极在反复充放电后会物理性解体。传统硅负极电池的容量衰减通常在几十次到几百次循环内就会出现明显下降，远不如此次研究中展示的性能。

补充讨论：
• [研究进展的亮点]  
   研究人员通过设计类似海绵的硅电极结构，成功缓解了硅的机械膨胀问题，使得硅负极电池的容量保持率在1700次循环后仍能达到80%，这一进展被认为是非常显著的。

• [对硅负极材料未来发展的期待]  
   尽管硅负极材料存在机械膨胀的问题，但通过结构设计上的创新，这一问题正在被逐步解决，未来有可能实现更长寿命和更高能量密度的锂电池。

争议焦点：
• 硅负极材料的机械膨胀问题是否能够完全解决，以及这种新设计是否能在实际应用中保持其优异性能。

Abstract
Ideal silicon negative electrodes for high-energy lithium-ion batteries are expected to feature high capacity, minimal expansion, long lifespan, and fast charging. Yet, engineered silicon materials face a fundamental paradox associated with particle deformation and charge transfer, which hinders the industrial use of advanced silicon electrode materials. Here we show a sieving-pore design for carbon supports that overcomes these mechano-kinetic limitations to enable stable, fast (de)alloying chemistries of silicon negative electrodes. Such a sieving-pore structure features an inner nanopore body with reserved voids to accommodate high-mass-content silicon deformation and an outer sub-nanopore entrance to induce both pre-desolvation and fast intrapore transport of ions during cycling. Importantly, the sieving effect yields inorganic-rich solid electrolyte interphases to mechanically confine the in-pore silicon, producing a stress-voltage coupling effect that mitigates the formation of detrimental crystalline Li
